aggregation.rule: never let state-dense races dominate silently

b_readiness: B implements source adapters + identity-safe alignment per adapter/comparison-frame contracts; no metrics, no fusion

calibration_role.MC2: frequencies are NOT calibrated real-world probabilities merely by being frequencies
calibration_role.V3.5: TOP5_SIGMOID_ONLY frozen; regressed out-of-time (kept as result)

driver_synchronization.rule: explicit support accounting per (state_id, driver_id); never zero-fill; never silent drop

eligibility_intersection.note: MC2 covers ~38% of states; never evaluate on supported rows without reporting exclusions

evaluation_splits.periods: development / calibration / comparison / evaluation to be fixed in D protocol
evaluation_splits.rule: race-level temporal separation; no random row splits; no driver-state leakage; no future tuning

fusion_gate.rule: V3.8E exists ONLY on FUSION_RESEARCH_WARRANTED from D; otherwise skip E and productize disagreement itself

fusion_prohibition: no CONSENSUS average, weighted average, 1-disagreement confidence, traffic lights, majority vote, or global certainty in A/B/C/D
ground_truth_boundary: historical outcomes EVALUATION ONLY; never in the predictive comparison frame
known_limitations: V3.5 P_win vs V3.1B near-duplicate (same Logistic family)

forbidden_pairs: model win probability vs V3.5 top-3 or other mismatched targets
is_not: not evidence either source is wrong

mc_sampling_uncertainty.implication: small model-vs-sim differences may be indistinguishable from MC sampling variation
mc_sampling_uncertainty.role: simulation-frequency interval / sampling SE for MC2 side only

no_silent_normalization.future_transforms: require explicit scientific rationale, separate evaluation, and preserved raw values
no_silent_normalization.rule: NEVER race-normalize, softmax, renormalize, or simplex-project any source-native output for convenience

ENSEMBLED_MODEL_PROBABILITY.uncertainty: model calibration error compounded by blending

INDEPENDENT_BINARY_MODEL_PROBABILITY.uncertainty: model calibration error; no MC sampling error

MARGINAL_THRESHOLD_PROBABILITY.uncertainty: model calibration error (top5 sigmoid regressed out-of-time)
MARGINAL_THRESHOLD_PROBABILITY.unit: one driver-state, cumulative thresholds with PAVA coherence

MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_SIMULATION_FREQUENCY.uncertainty: finite-simulation sampling variability; NOT model confidence, NOT real-world uncertainty
MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_SIMULATION_FREQUENCY.unit: whole race (one winner per valid trial)

rank_rules.note: rank comparison needs no shared normalization semantics
rank_rules.ties: explicit tie handling required in B; no silent averaging

scientific_question: What can be learned from the agreement and disagreement between distinct predictive mechanisms viewing the same factual race state? Disagreement is information; fusion must earn its way through evidence.
source_independence: claim only 'distinct predictive mechanisms': models share ALL_84 feature family + 2018-2024 training data; MC2 shares RaceState(T) init but is generative, not discriminative

MC2.rationale: mutually exclusive joint futures; sums to 1 by construction; distinct generative mechanism
MC2.target: simulated winner frequency (+ derivable top-k from frozen full-field distributions)

V3.1B_LOGISTIC.rationale: frozen champion, RAW independent per-driver binaries, never normalized; established winner lineage

V3.3_XGBOOST.rationale: same task/semantics as V3.1B; standalone superiority not established; diversity candidate only

V3.4_ENSEMBLE.rationale: mathematically blends two admitted sources; treating it as an independent vote double-counts model information

V3.5_MARGINALS.rationale: per-driver marginals, not joint; top-k contextual only; champion is same Logistic family (diagnostic vs V3.1B at 3e-11)
V3.5_MARGINALS.target: P(finish<=1/3/5/10); only P_win target-compatible with winner probability

stage_plan: V3.8E fusion ONLY if D justifies

stages.definition: frozen M0 thirds on race_progress_frac: EARLY [0,1/3), MID [1/3,2/3), LATE [2/3,1]

status_2025: REVEALED_HOLDOUT / NON_PRISTINE — consumed once each by V3.1B/V3.3/V3.5; never touched by MC2; excluded from product paths. Never call it unseen/pristine; no product expansion to 2025.

context_only: V3.5 P(finish<=3/5/10) vs MC2 derived top-k (same frozen distributions, no new science)

terminology.consensus_means: analysis of agreement/disagreement between distinct predictive mechanisms, NOT a fused probability

threshold_policy: dimensions frozen in A; numerical thresholds require D evidence, never frozen in A
title: Model x Simulation Consensus — Scientific Contract + Source Audit
v310_boundary: no unified Intelligence Explorer; V3.8G surface must stay composable for V3.10
v39_boundary: V3.8 exposes disagreement + MC sampling info; never creates a universal uncertainty score (V3.9 owns uncertainty intelligence)
